evidence.sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT region, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS monthly_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY region, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date)), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(monthly_revenue) AS avg_monthly_revenue, AVG(monthly_revenue * monthly_revenue) - AVG(monthly_revenue) * AVG(monthly_revenue) AS variance, COUNT(*) AS month_count FROM monthly_revenue GROUP BY region) SELECT mr.region, mr.month, mr.monthly_revenue, rs.avg_monthly_revenue, SQRT(rs.variance) AS stddev_monthly_revenue, CASE WHEN rs.avg_monthly_revenue > 0 THEN SQRT(rs.variance) / rs.avg_monthly_revenue ELSE NULL END AS coefficient_of_variation FROM monthly_revenue AS mr JOIN region_stats AS rs ON mr.region = rs.region ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC, mr.region, mr.month LIMIT 100
evidence.result_summary: 返回 95 行。 monthly_revenue从 7561.89 变化到 4632.04, 变化 -38.74%。 avg_monthly_revenue从 7543.54 变化到 7543.54, 变化 +0.00%。 stddev_monthly_revenue从 3316.61 变化到 3316.61, 变化 +0.00%。 coefficient_of_variation从 0.439662 变化到 0.439662, 变化 +0.00%。

evidence.sql: WITH region_monthly AS (SELECT region, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS monthly_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY region, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date)), region_stats AS (SELECT region, MAX(monthly_revenue) AS max_monthly_revenue, MIN(monthly_revenue) AS min_monthly_revenue, SUM(monthly_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region_monthly GROUP BY region), region_volatility AS (SELECT region, (max_monthly_revenue - min_monthly_revenue) AS revenue_range, (max_monthly_revenue - min_monthly_revenue) * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_revenue, 0) AS volatility_ratio FROM region_stats) SELECT rm.region, rm.month, rm.monthly_revenue FROM region_monthly AS rm JOIN (SELECT region FROM region_volatility ORDER BY volatility_ratio DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_region ON rm.region = top_region.region ORDER BY rm.month LIMIT 100

套餐维度中，Starter套餐占比最高（34.5%），Enterprise套餐占比最低（11%）；各套餐流失率介于11.1%至38.3%之间。
获客渠道维度中，Outbound渠道客户数最多，Paid Search渠道客户数最少；各渠道流失率介于19.23%至52.38%之间。

key_findings.statement: 按折扣区间分组，0.1_0.2区间销量最高（1590件），under_0.1区间销量最低（749件）；0.1_0.2区间收入也最高（732472.04元），under_0.1区间收入最低（302852.86元）。
各折扣区间的退款订单明细占比在13.26%至16.57%之间，0.1_0.2区间退款占比最高（16.57%），under_0.1区间最低（13.26%）。
折扣字段实际取值覆盖zero_discount、0.1_0.2等区间，其中zero_discount区间订单明细数最多（519件），0.1_0.2区间最少（271件）；退款率在12.32%至16.05%之间，0.1_0.2区间退款率最高（16.05%）。
在0.1_0.2折扣区间内按产品类别分组，Accessories类别销量最高（381件），Networking类别销量最低（123件）；Accessories类别收入也最高（276514.46元），且其退款订单占比最高（16.22%），Networking类别退款订单占比最低（9.2%）。

在0.1_0.2折扣区间内，Accessories类别随时间（2024-01-16至2025-12-06）的销量、收入及退款率存在波动，单日销量在1至10件之间，单日收入在55.46至1878.66元之间，退款率在0至1之间，未显示异常集中在特定时间段的明确证据。
